body: I stand up slowly, my heart beating with a soft, protective rhythm, as I watch the drone zip away into the distance. The ribboned box glides gracefully down the path, its contents spilling out onto the soft earth. A sudden jolt of excitement runs through me, and I feel a surge of nurturing energy. I carefully make my way towards the box, my eyes fixed on it with a mix of curiosity and concern.
